Our story

Where rice meets spice

Zeva Mandi & Grills is a Turkish and Arabic themed multi-cuisine restaurant in Bolar, Mangaluru, bringing the flavours of the Gulf to Morgans Gate Road — tender meat slow-cooked and smoked over fragrant basmati rice with Arabian spices.

Guests talk about the friendly service, the ambience and the grilled chicken mandi — 4.7 stars from 82 Google reviewers and counting. Whether it's a family dinner or a quick plate of grills, the table is set.

Good to know

Frequently asked

Where is the best mandi restaurant in Mangalore?
Zeva Mandi & Grills is a mandi restaurant in Mangalore located at Shop no G03 Jeppu, Arfa Mirage tower, Morgans Gate Rd, Bolar, Mangaluru 575001 — near Zudio, Bolar. It serves Arabic and Turkish style mandi and grills and is rated 4.7 stars by 82 Google reviewers.
What are the opening hours of Zeva Mandi & Grills Mangalore?
Zeva Mandi & Grills in Bolar, Mangaluru is open every day of the week from 12:00 PM to 11:00 PM.
What dishes are famous at Zeva Mandi & Grills?
Guest favourites include chicken mandi, grilled chicken mandi, mutton mandi, pahadi chicken tikka, dragon chicken, afghani chicken gravy and a range of charcoal grills and Turkish and Arabic starters.
What is mandi?
Mandi is a traditional Arabic rice dish in which meat is slow-cooked and smoked over fragrant basmati rice cooked with Arabian spices. Zeva Mandi & Grills prepares it in the traditional way for dine-in guests in Mangaluru.
How do I contact or order from Zeva Mandi & Grills, Bolar Mangaluru?
Call Zeva Mandi & Grills at +91 70227 71888 to ask about the menu, takeaway and table reservations. The restaurant is open daily from 12 PM to 11 PM.
How do I leave a Google review for Zeva Mandi & Grills?
Search Zeva Mandi & Grills on Google Maps and tap Write a review, or scan the QR code on the table card, which opens the Google review page directly. See the printable review card →
What are the prices at Zeva Mandi & Grills?
The new soft launch menu starts at ₹30 for a rotti and ₹50 for fresh juices. Mandi is priced by portion — Alfaham and Classic Chicken Mandi from ₹250 (quarter) to ₹980 (full), Grill Mutton Mandi from ₹420 to ₹1,800 — and all prices are exclusive of GST.
